description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain known for using fresh dough made from 100% Canadian wheat and organic tomato sauce, with a broad menu of customizable pizzas, salads, sides, and desserts. This North Vancouver location on Hastings Street offers delivery and takeout. The chain emphasizes clean ingredients with no artificial colours or flavours, making it a convenient calorie-replenishment stop for cyclists passing through the area.
